title: XTI Aerospace Announces Completion of Internal Review; On Track to File Quarterly Report on Form 10-Q By October 26, 2026
summary: DALLAS, Oct. 13, 2026 /PRNewswire/ -- XTI Aerospace, Inc. (Nasdaq: XTIA) ("XTI Aerospace," "XTI" or the "Company"), an aerospace and advanced technology
body_markdown:
DALLAS, Oct. 13, 2026 /PRNewswire/ — XTI Aerospace, Inc. (Nasdaq: XTIA) (“XTI Aerospace,” “XTI” or the “Company”), an aerospace and advanced technology platform and parent company of Drone Nerds, LLC (“Drone Nerds”), a leading drone solutions platform serving commercial, enterprise and government customers, today announced that its internal review, initiated in July 2026, has been completed and the Company is on track to file its Form 10-Q by October 26, 2026.


“With the internal review complete, I am happy to report that there were no financial misstatements discovered and we are on track to report our second quarter results later this month,” said Jeremy Schneiderman, Interim CEO. “With this assessment behind us, we believe we are better positioned to ensure that our corporate governance procedures meet the highest standards of compliance and transparency moving forward. We appreciate the patience and support of our employees, partners, customers, and shareholders during this process as we build a best-in-class governance structure.”


The internal review was overseen by a special committee of independent directors of the Company’s Board of Directors (the “Special Committee”), with the assistance of independent outside counsel. The Special Committee has reported to the Board of Directors on the completion of the review.


Consistent with its ongoing commitment to strong corporate governance, the Company intends to implement, under the oversight of the Board of Directors, certain enhancements to its governance framework, policies and procedures. The Board will continue to evaluate the Company’s governance practices and may adopt additional measures as it deems appropriate.


**Preliminary Second Quarter Results**


The Company anticipates reporting second quarter revenue of approximately $32.4 million, gross profit of approximately $5.6 million and loss from operations of approximately $9.1 million.


The preliminary financial information in this press release is unaudited, reflects management’s current estimates based on information available as of the date of this press release, and remains subject to the completion of the Company’s financial closing procedures and the review of the Company’s independent registered public accounting firm. The Company’s actual results for the second quarter may differ from these preliminary estimates.


**Update on 2026 Guidance**


The Company is withdrawing its previously issued 2026 financial guidance at this time and expects to provide a comprehensive update at a later date.


**About XTI Aerospace, Inc.**


XTI Aerospace, Inc. (“XTI”) (Nasdaq: XTIA), headquartered in Dallas, Texas, is focused on building a leading platform for commercial and government drone adoption in the growing unmanned aircraft systems (“UAS”) industry. Through its subsidiary, Drone Nerds, LLC, XTI supports enterprise and government customers in sectors including public safety, agriculture, construction, and energy across the drone program lifecycle, from hardware sourcing and deployment to training, service, repair, and the Always Flying program. Its established U.S. customer base and reputation as a trusted solutions provider position the company as a go-to-market partner for drone manufacturers and software developers seeking to scale in the domestic market.
